title: Previous-year question record
description: One normalized question from a previous-year Telangana Police SI / Constable paper. Every field the preparation system may eventually need is present; fields that are not yet known are null. Validated by hand-written checks in tests/pyq/test_pyq_foundation.py (D-0006).

paper_id.description: Must resolve to a registered paper.

question_number.description: Position in the printed paper. Missing is allowed only when the paper's numbering is unreadable; the extraction issue must be recorded.

stem.description: The question text, verbatim from the source.

stem_te.description: Telugu companion field (D-0004). A translation, never an independent claim.

correct_answer.description: The keyed answer, if a key exists. null (with answer_source UNVERIFIED) means no key was seen.

answer_source.description: Where the correct answer, if recorded, came from. Required on every question, even a null correct_answer, so a question without a key is visibly unverified rather than silently assumed.

subject.description: Arithmetic & Test of Reasoning / Mental Ability, or General Studies, etc.

post_code.description: Which post the paper was for, if the paper defines post codes.

solving_method.description: The standard method, with its source.

verified_fast_method.description: The fast method, if independently verified. Never a model guess.

fast_method_source.description: Where the fast method came from, including its provenance tier.

confusion_pairs.description: Concepts this question is commonly confused with.

extraction_issues.description: Anything unresolved about extracting this question (unreadable number, crop, etc.).

source_document_id.description: Paper id in config/pyq_documents.json or the paper record id this question came from.

invariants: provenance.paper_id (or provenance.source_document_id) must resolve to a registered paper — a question with no paper is unsourced
answer_source is present on every question, including those without a key
correct_answer != null  =>  answer_source != UNVERIFIED (a keyed answer must name where the key came from)
source_type == OFFICIAL_PUBLICATION  =>  provenance.url is on a board host, else the tier is not OFFICIAL_PUBLICATION
provenance_tier is T2_HISTORICAL_PYQ and is never relabelled T1_OFFICIAL
a retrieved paper with normalized_questions_status == NONE cannot be the source of any question
